column1: # Instruction legality / validation table @ VA 0x22FEE00..0x2339E00 (241664 B = 60416 u32)
# Flat sparse view: every NON-ZERO u32 with its index/VA and value-class.
# Layout is a packed record table (dominant stride 24 B = 6 u32) but record size varies by region;
# the reliable binary facts are the value-classes below. Records group as {key, handler/ptr}.
# value classes: text_handler_ptr=dedicated (opcode,modifier) validator/encoder fn in .text;
#   special_validation_sentinel=0x08000000 (no dedicated handler; run generic validation path).
